name: Dentata
source:
A dead mall opens in a small town in western Poland , inviting a perspective to pasts and futures of its inhabitants. In the vestiges of the transformations, a boy cheats on a girl.

[From [url=https://puapka.itch.io/dentata]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
波兰西部的一座小镇上开起了一家萧条死寂的商场，由此映照出当地居民的过往与未来。在时代变迁的残迹之中，一个男孩背叛了一个女孩。

[摘自[url=https://puapka.itch.io/dentata]itch.io[/url]]
